implementation.name: original-v1-serving-pipeline-timing
implementation.scope: Original alternative schedules, symbolic equal-width slots, one GPU; source A has two requests and B four.
implementation.question: How do different requests overlap on the same CPU and GPU?

purpose: Make request identity, readiness, and concurrent resource progress visible within the original schedule.
storyboard: Prepare R1 before the GPU consumes it.
Prepare R2 while the same GPU executes R1.
Keep each next request ready until its own handoff.
Drain all four illustrated requests without comparing unequal-workload counts.
guard: No measured timing, automatic full utilization, or matched-workload speedup ratio. GPU1…4 are requests, not devices.
